name: Günlük Trend Motoru v1
start: earliest available official monthly daily archive among eligible product identities; initial months may have fewer than 50 products or none with 100 days
atr: Wilder ATR20, initial average of first 20 true ranges, signal day included
entry_channel: 20 daily bars before signal bar, signal bar excluded; strict close breakout
stop_channel: 10 days before the just-closed update day, update day excluded; first update after the entry day closes; effective only from that close onward
entry: next daily open for history, fresh quote for live; all same-time candidates sorted by latest 30 closed days quote volume, symbol tie-break
same_coin: a position still open at signal close blocks that signal even if it gaps out at the next open
funding: published actual signed rates on fixed entry notional; entry < funding time <= exit; timestamp rounded down to whole second; missing actual funding is unverified, no invented rate
funding_archive_completion: unpublished monthly archive fetched from official www.binance.com/fapi/v1/fundingRate, original response normalized and cached
intraday: daily stop contact resolved with original futures 1m solely for exit timestamp and pre-exit excursion, no minute-based entry filter; terminal minute extrema excluded, exit price included; minute close minus 1ms used unless gap
mfe_mae: initial 2N units, full held days and known pre-stop minutes; post-exit movement excluded; terminal minute within-minute extrema not identifiable
direction: full five UTC days after backtest entry, irrespective of early exit; insufficient forward data => unverified
capital: 10000 USDT, each entry risks 1% of then-current marked-to-market equity; initial 2N defines immutable R; 0.15% of entry notional charged at entry and 0.15% at exit; no leverage, liquidation or borrowing constraints modelled
mark_to_market: daily closing NAV includes open unrealized PnL and funding accrued; no forced end-of-sample close; no future exit fees deducted from still-open positions
data_end_delist: do not fabricate delist settlement or fills in zero-trade placeholder candles; retain unresolved exposure and label data uncertainty, preventing validated PASS; unavailable next traded open is recorded as an unfilled signal
annual: closed net R grouped by exit year; NAV return uses calendar-year equity; partial years count in majority test
last12: closed trades by exit timestamp in final 12 calendar months
stress: same accepted trade list, no capacity refill after top-three removal, no retuning
benchmark: underlying BTC price represented by same-period futures daily candles; gross unlevered buy-and-hold, no funding; daily-close drawdown
live: disabled until GEÇTİ report and explicit report-bound user approval
